D5: Multi-chain addresses discovered from docs. Ethereum: 13 core + 12 adapters. Berachain: rUSD/srUSD/wsrUSD OFT + Berachain Markets adapter. Base: rUSD/wsrUSD OFT. Arbitrum: rUSD/wsrUSD OFT. BNB: rUSD/wsrUSD OFT + DAM OFT. World Chain: rUSD/wsrUSD OFT + World Chain Markets adapter. Plasma: Plasma Markets adapter. HyperEVM: rUSD/wsrUSD OFT. Unichain, Sei, Avalanche, Linea, Monad, Katana, Plume, Sonic: rUSD/wsrUSD OFT each. Solana: rUSD/wsrUSD SPL addresses (non-EVM, excluded from admin_addresses). Block-explorer name-tag searches not performed per chain due to exhausted search quota.
D6: No factory contracts identified. Asset adapters are individually listed in official docs rather than enumerated from a factory. No factory-pattern enumeration needed.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: token (rUSD, srUSD, wsrUSD, trUSD, DAM), other (DAM Staking), other (PSM USDC/USDT/USD1), vault (Saving Module), other (Term Issuer), admin (Credit Enforcer), other (rUSD Mint Bridge), other (OFT Adapters), other (Asset Adapters), admin (constructor admin EOA 0x6Ed13690efCc6f10217011E35Cffef4516F458bb).

protocol_metadata.about: Reservoir is a CDP-based stablecoin protocol incubated by Fortunafi that allows users to deposit USDC or approved collateral (including RWAs such as tokenized Treasury bills) to mint rUSD, a 1:1 dollar-pegged stablecoin. Users can further exchange rUSD for srUSD (a liquid variable-rate yield-bearing token) or trUSD (a fixed-term coupon token), with yield sourced from on-chain DeFi strategies and real-world assets. A Credit Enforcer contract automatically enforces three solvency ratios — liquidity, asset, and equity — reverting any transaction that would breach protocol-set minimums, while a Peg Stability Module maintains a USDC/USDT redemption buffer. The protocol is deployed natively on Ethereum with OFT (LayerZero) cross-chain token transfers to over 15 chains, and its governance token DAM controls asset adapter allocations and risk parameters.
